Add pros and cons with weights to get a verdict.

📖 How to use

  1. Type the decision you are weighing.
  2. Add pros and cons, each with an importance weight of 1–5.
  3. Read the verdict and the weighted score breakdown.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the decision scored?

Each pro and con gets a weight from 1 (minor) to 5 (deal-breaker). Totals are compared to produce the verdict.

What does 'toss-up' mean?

If the weighted totals are within 10% of each other, the result is a toss-up — the decision genuinely could go either way.

Can I add more pros and cons?

Yes — add as many rows as you need on either side.

Is this private?

Yes, everything runs locally in your browser.
